Description (Monument Details): SOUTH AUSTRALIAN WAR MEMORIAL - GREAT WAR WW1 1914 - 1918
Monument Descripti (Monument Details):
South Australian War Memorial
Sculptural elements by George Rayner Hoff
Frame designed by Woods, Bagot, Jory & Laybourne-Smith 
Sculptural elements include "Sacrifice", a white Angaston marble sectional sculpture in bas relief depicting the Angel Gabriel
Before which stands a cast bronze sculptural group depicting a farmer, a scholar and a young woman responding to duty
The reverse exterior bears a carving in bas relief depicting the Spirit of Womanhood and the Spirit of Compassion carrying a sheathed sword and bearing the fallen
Below which a cast bronze fountain head in the form of an imperial lion spills in to an oval pond
An inscription by English poet, John Oxenham (William Arthur Dunkerley) reads "All honour give to those who, nobly striving, nobly fell that we might live"
The sculptural elements are contained within a grey Macclesfield and Harcourt granite stepped frame with domed alcove
The interior of the structure contains an inner shrine carrying the names of the fallen through action in the First World War

Fouteen Pieces Fountains
Known as "DINOSAUR BONES"
By Hussein and Angela Valamanesh
Sculptural representation of vertebrae being fourteen carved irregular form fountain plinths in Adelaide black granite 
The upper surface of which is honed to a shallow basin
The reticulated fountain action released under stainless steel disc and flows uniformly over the edge of the structure down the roughly hewn sides and in to a subterranean reservoir which then reticulates the waters
The sculptural fountain is set in to a sloping Cacca (pink granite) paved plaza and incorporates button light illumination
Overall m2 approx. 6 x 7 m
